messages:
incident-bot: [ALERT] Spike in 5xx and gateway timeouts observed from control-plane ingress (api.redwood.com). Auto-pager triggered for oncall-group. See: https://internal/redwood/runbooks/controlplane-deps

oncall-bot: Pager -> Priya M. (primary). Priority P1. Paging channel: #incidents.

Priya M.: acknowledging. Quick snapshot: error rate jumped ~09:12Z, mostly 502/504 from /v1/org/lookup and /v1/billing/charge endpoints proxied through gateway. Some clients report failed requests and elevated latencies.

Omar L.: digging in traces. Pattern: org-store read fanout grew after a recent config push that enabled index-parallelization and lowered cache TTLs. We see increased DB query latency and transient connection saturation to org-store replicas. billing-service also shows retry storms.

Zoe R.: logs snippets:
```
proxy 2026-03-20T09:13:04Z GET /v1/org/lookup 504 upstream_read_timeout svc-proxy
org-store 2026-03-20T09:12:58Z WARN query_slow qid=0x1fa latency=5.4s plan=parallel_index
billing 2026-03-20T09:13:01Z ERROR downstream_timeout retry=3
```

infra-bot: Noted recent deploy: controlplane-config v2026-03-20T09:10 promoted to canary. Commit: a7c9f0. Link: https://git.internal/redwood/controlplane-config/commit/a7c9f0

Priya M.: immediate mitigation proposals:
- revert recent config canary to stop the new index parallelization
- enable proxy-level short-circuit for org lookup (serve stale cache when upstream slow)
- reduce gateway keepalive to shed slow connections (protect control-plane)
- scale org-store read replicas and increase db connection pool temporarily
- apply backoff on billing retry paths to avoid amplifying load

Omar L.: running rollback on canary now: `redwoodctl deploy rollback controlplane-config --to previous --canary-only`

Zoe R.: applying proxy quick-tune: set `proxy_max_in_flight=80` -> lowering to 40 to throttle downstream; set `proxy_conn_timeout=1.5s` and `proxy_read_timeout=4s`. Pushing config to gateway group 2.

infra-bot: Rolling scale: `kubectl scale deploy/org-store-read --replicas=8 -n controlplane` executed. Noted CPU boost and new pods entering ready.

Priya M.: also enabling stale-serve for org-cache: config snippet applied to svc-auth cache:
```
CACHE_MODE=stale_while_revalidate
CACHE_TTL=300
STALE_TTL=60
```
This will let auth respond with slightly stale entries while revalidation happens.

Omar L.: after rollback and cache changes we see error rate drop from 20% -> 7% within two minutes. DB slow queries falling back to baseline on canary hosts. Billing spike moving down after we patched retry backoff.

Zoe R.: added temporary traffic-split: 20% of control-plane traffic diverted to secondary region (eu-west) for non-auth-critical routes to relieve load here. Command: `redwoodctl traffic split --service controlplane --percent 20 --region eu-west`

Priya M.: customer impact note: Affected areas: login, org metadata endpoints, and billing API calls for heavy tenants. We sent a short CS message: "We are mitigating an elevated error rate affecting login and org lookup. Mitigation underway; ETA ~30-45m. Updates every 20m."

infra-bot: Observability: Grafana panels updated: p90 org-store latency fell from 3.2s -> 450ms; control-plane 5xx dropped to ~5%. Link: https://grafana.internal/d/ops/controlplane-deps?org=redwood

Omar L.: follow-up: we should reduce aggressive parallel index plans in DB engine. That config is the immediate culprit; plan change interacts poorly with cold cache and causes bursts of heavy IO. Opening DB ticket and scheduling query-plan revert during maintenance.

Priya M.: next steps during handoff: Zoe will monitor gateway and proxy tuning for 1 hour; Omar to validate DB replica health and query plans; infra to run a dedicated cache warmup job for top 50 org keys. I'll file a post-incident memo with timeline and owners. If errors exceed 10% again, escalate to Platform Lead.

Zoe R.: warmup job kicked off. small script to prefetch keys for heavy tenants.
```
for org in $(cat heavy_orgs.txt); do curl -sS https://api.redwood.com/v1/org/$org/lookup >/dev/null; done
```

Priya M.: re-checking dashboards at 09:37Z: stable at baseline. Preparing to close pager if stable for 30m.

incident-bot: Incident status -> acknowledged -> monitoring. SLA: affected tenants flagged for postmortem review.

infra-bot: Created task INC-7881: "Revert DB parallel index plan and review canary verification for cache-sensitive changes." Assigned to Omar L.

Priya M.: thanks everyone. Handing off monitoring to Omar for next 90 minutes. I'll draft the incident summary and publish in #incident-postmortems.

incident-bot: Incident resolved: 5xx rate returned to normal. Resolved at 2026-03-20T10:00:00Z.

Priya M.: closing thread. Postmortem to follow. :white_check_mark:
